title: Dual bound for a self-adjoint operator
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q,p',q',C\in\mathbb R$, and suppose $p'$ is Hölder-conjugate to $p$ and $q'$ is Hölder-conjugate to $q$. If a linear operator $T$ on real-valued functions on $\Omega$ is self-adjoint for the uniform inner product and satisfies $\|Tf\|_q\le C\|f\|_p$ for every such function $f$, then $\|Tg\|_{p'}\le C\|g\|_{q'}$ for every such function $g$, where these norms are taken with respect to the uniform probability measure on $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is self-adjoint for the uniform inner product
$\|Tf\|_q\le C\|f\|_p$ for every real-valued function $f$ on $\Omega$
